title: Generalized Svetlichny Inequalities as a Cross-Platform Benchmark for Quantum Processors
summary: A cross-platform benchmark should be device-independent yet sensitive to imperfections accumulated during execution. Building on prior work, we formulate and validate a protocol through demonstrations based on generalized Svetlichny inequality violations (a simulation, rather than a loophole-free certification, of multipartite nonlocality) for larger subsystem sizes.
